Five-epoch single-mode MX weight-training pilot, with an optional matched
control. CUDA production; SVHN train only. No warm-start, truncation or
distillation. The original forward function is used with internal selector
[32]; the adapter selects actual MX weights, while activations and the BN bank
remain at A32.

positional arguments:
